title: Terms for Cancelling or Missing an Immunization Services Appointment
content:
These terms bind every patient who books an Immunization Services vaccination appointment. The cancellation cutoff hours, the marker that a late cancellation counts as a no-show, and the late-arrival grace minutes are those of the appointment's vaccination in the product tables.

**Term 1 — Timely cancellation.** An appointment is cancelled with no consequence when the cancellation is made at least the cancellation cutoff hours before the appointment time.

**Term 2 — Late cancellation.** Where the vaccination marks a late cancellation as a no-show, a cancellation made later than the cutoff is recorded as a no-show instead of a cancellation.

**Term 3 — Late arrival.** A patient not arrived the late-arrival grace minutes after the appointment time is recorded as a no-show.

**Term 4 — One outcome per appointment.** Each appointment ends at most once, by a cancellation, a no-show or a dose. An appointment that already carries one of these outcomes takes no second one.

**Term 5 — No fee.** Kestrel charges no fee for a cancellation or a no-show. The only consequence of a no-show is the suspension of online and phone booking once the patient's no-shows in rolling 365 days reach the vaccination's limit.

## The terms as outcomes

| When the patient acts | Recorded as | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| Cancels at least the cutoff hours before the appointment time | Cancellation | None |
| Cancels later than that, where the vaccination marks late cancellation as a no-show | No-show | None |
| Has not arrived the grace minutes after the appointment time | No-show | None |
| Appointment already ended by a cancellation, no-show or dose | No further outcome | None |

## Hypothetical illustration

An appointment at 09:00 for a vaccination with a cutoff of 2 hours and a grace of 15 minutes: a cancellation at 07:00 is a cancellation; a cancellation at 07:30 is recorded as a no-show; a patient not arrived at 09:15 is recorded as a no-show; in none of these cases is a fee charged.
